messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected in eu-west-1. p95 latency > 600ms, p99 spike to ~2.3s for router ingress. Streaming stalls reported (streaming sessions with long tail). Auto-escalation -> page to on-call.

maya: I’m on it — reproing dashboards now. seeing a correlated increase in router queue depth and LB retry rates. creating thread here for live triage. @sre-tina are you able to join? :eyes:

sre-tina: joining. I can see the spike. p50 ~120ms, p95 ~620ms, p99 ~2300ms. Error responses are low, mostly successful but slow. Suspect misrouting to a few overloaded shards.

raj: noticed a pattern — a handful of upstream targets in eu-west-1 show 10-20x higher active connections. Could be imbalance from recent routing policy rollout (weight-config v2). Rolling window shows last deploy 14:37 UTC.

anya: customers reporting streaming stalls in embed generation pipeline (customer: lia-company). Lia said chunks pause for ~3-4s intermittently. adding them to incident channel.

ops-jen: confirmed increased 502/timeout retries on edge LB to internal router. LB metrics: steady backend healthy checks, but sticky routing percentages jumped to ~12% on two nodes.

maya: quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle new connections to the two overloaded targets, 2) force-route traffic away from the suspect affinity buckets, 3) enable eager fallback to smaller model pool for degraded requests. Thoughts?

sre-tina: agree. Do step 1 by adjusting routing weights temporarily. I’ll run a targeted weight shift to reduce weight for nodes host-eu-022 and host-eu-024 by 70%. Command below (dry-run first):

```
# routerctl set-weight --scope eu-west-1 --target host-eu-022,host-eu-024 --factor 0.3 --dry-run
# routerctl set-weight --scope eu-west-1 --target host-eu-022,host-eu-024 --factor 0.3
```

raj: also toggling LB anti-sticky flag to allow rebalancing across healthy pool: `lbctl update-policy --region eu-west-1 --anti-sticky enabled` — will apply in 30s.

product-simon: any customer-facing impact? liaison notes stall but not full failures. need ETA for update to ops team and to Lia.

maya: initial customer impact: intermittent stalls up to 4s for a subset of streaming requests (~0.6% of total traffic in region). Not systemic failures. Will inform Lia and update docs.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026 assigned to maya, priority P1.

sre-tina: weight change applied. Observing immediate drop in active connections on host-eu-022/024. p99 down to ~1.1s within 90s.

ops-jen: LB anti-sticky flag applied. upstream allocation smoothing in progress. connection churn increasing slightly as clients reestablish, but tail latency trending down.

maya: enabling eager fallback now for streaming routes to use smaller quantized model pool when latency > 800ms.

anya: customers who hit fallback will see slightly lower cost/accuracy tradeoff — notifying Lia with suggested mitigation details.

raj: follow-up checks: no CPU/GPU saturation on those hosts; memory/KV cache hit rates on overloaded nodes were abnormally low — looks like hot-partitioning of KV caches (skewed prefix locality). Could be routing policy seeding bug.

sre-tina: filing a rollback for the recent routing policy seed change (deploy 14:37). If rollback not safe, will patch policy generator to rebalance seeds. Assigning to infra-reach team for root-cause.

product-simon: please prepare a short customer summary for Lia: timeline, mitigations, and next steps. We’ll offer a post-incident note after RCA.

maya: status update to Lia: "We observed a routing imbalance in eu-west-1 causing a small subset of streaming requests to hit overloaded router shards, leading to intermittent 2-4s stalls. Mitigations applied: routing weight reduction on two hosts, LB anti-sticky toggle, and enabling temporary eager fallback. p95/p99 improving; monitoring closely." Sending now.

maya: Lia reply: "Thanks — we saw the pauses stop after ~90s, appreciate the quick response. Please keep us posted on RCA."

sre-tina: p99 now ~420ms and trending to normal (~180ms). Keeping mitigations in place while infra team investigates seed logic.

raj: collecting logs and the policy rollout diff. I’ll hand over artifacts: router logs, weight-change timestamps, LB policy change audit, and cache heatmaps.

ops-jen: creating follow-up tickets: INC-2026-POSTMORTEM and INFRA-2026-routing-seed-bug. Adding action items: improved canary for routing policy, KV cache heatmap alarms, and automatic reweighting when active_conn skew > 5x.

maya: oncall handoff at +30m: @sre-tina will take monitoring. I’ll draft the incident summary for the livepage and postmortem.

sre-tina: Ack. Monitoring throttles and will alert if p99 > 800ms for >2m. Leaving a check-in at +60m.

product-simon: thanks team. Lia flagged one more customer impacted earlier — we’ll reach out after RCA.

maya: incident declared mitigated at 3367894360. Next: RCA triage session at 12:00 UTC tomorrow. Closing livepage but keeping tickets open for follow-up.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026 status changed to Mitigated.
